tagline: Swim for real · Explore · Go further together
lead: SwimQuest is a team swimming voyage: every real swim you log moves your team's ship further across the map, from the Da Nang coast out to Ly Son island.

how.title: How the voyage works
how.intro: Seven legs, from signing up to your team landing on Ly Son.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.body: Sign up with your email in seconds.

tournament.title: Create a tournament
tournament.body: Organisers open a tournament and set its dates and teams.

team.title: Create or join a team
team.body: Start your own team or join one through an invite link.

start.title: Pick a starting point
start.body: Your team picks a beach to start the voyage from.

swim.title: Swim & log it
swim.body: Swim for real, then send your swim to have it counted.

progress.title: Track progress
progress.body: Watch your team's ship move along the map.

finish.title: Land on Ly Son
finish.body: Reach the finish together and earn your badges.

cta.title: Ready to set sail?
cta.body: Join your team and start the winter voyage.

safety.title: Swim safely
safety.body: The map is game art, not a real swimming route. Swim somewhere safe, within your limits, and never alone.
